title: Homogeneous commutative algebras in small etale module sheaves
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ with its small etale ringed site and module sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space]. For a family $B_d$ of module sheaves, a commutative unital graded algebra structure consists of additive-in-each-variable homogeneous products $B_m(V)\times B_n(V)\to B_{m+n}(V)$ linear over $\mathcal O_X(V)$ in both variables, commuting with every chart restriction, associative, ordinarily commutative, and with a module map $\mathcal O_X\to B_0$ satisfying both unit laws. These are equivalently sheaf tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. A homogeneous algebra homomorphism is a family of module maps preserving products and the unit. The total object is the coproduct of the $B_d$ in module sheaves; the homogeneous products determine its products by bilinearity and sheafification. No assertion that sections commute with infinite coproducts is included. This is the small-etale analogue of the Zariski notion [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures].
